messages:
nina: Heads-up: product wants to retire the `X-Route` header in ~7 weeks. We need a coordinated plan across console, SDKs, and telemetry.
omar: Agreed. Keep UX noise to admins only (tenant banner + overview). No per-user toasts.
lucy: SDK ergonomics: add a `legacyRouting` client option (default true for the next 2 releases). Emit a single startup DeprecationWarning and provide an env var to force legacy during testing.
kevin: Go note: runtime warnings are rough; prefer log.Warn and expose `/debug/compat` or a prometheus gauge like `redwood_routing_compat{mode="legacy"}` so ops can scrape.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/route-header-retire -> canary 2024-05-20 02:30 UTC :calendar:
nina: Telemetry: add `routing.header_mode` tag enum: `legacy`, `new`, `none`. Ingestion to run a bounded backfill (30d) scanning raw logs for the old header to seed historical baselines.
omar: Dashboard: ops wants top-20 tenants by legacy pct + WoW delta. Once tag exists the tile should be straightforward.
lucy: Python plan: release 0.9.0 implementing adapter that sends legacy header when `legacyRouting=True`, logs DeprecationWarning on import. 0.10.0 flips default to False. Provide `REDWOOD_FORCE_LEGACY=1` for opt-back-in.
kevin: TS plan: match shape but avoid breaking types. Export `RoutingOptions` with `legacyRouting?: boolean`. Use `console.warn` in browsers and `process.emitWarning` in node.
nina: Support/export: console CSV should include tenant_id, api_key_hash, legacy_pct, suspected_proxy_rewrite, owner_email. Good for outreach.
omar: Proxy-rewrite detection: flag tenants where SDK version >= adapterRelease but header still present = proxy-inserts. Also flag SDK < adapterRelease but header absent = early migration. Both need manual follow-up.
lucy: Add Envoy filter snippet to docs for teams that want to strip header proactively, include rollback snippet.
kevin: Timeline proposal: Week0 announce; Week1 telemetry + dashboard; Week2-5 SDK adapter releases (py/ts/go); Week6 flip defaults off; Week9 stop accepting legacy header server-side with 2-week rollback window.
deploy-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/route-retire-1719802468 :white_check_mark:
nina: I'll draft comms + migration guide. Owners: telemetry=omar, sdk-py=lucy, sdk-ts=kevin, console=jessica (assigning separately). Blockers?
kevin: Small ask: add `--simulate-legacy` CLI flag in SDKs so SEs can validate locally.
lucy: Agree. Also add unit tests asserting `routing.header_mode` tag is set correctly for legacy/new/none.
omar: Ingestion: backfill capped at 30 days and will run off-peak. Storage looks fine.
nina: Perfect. I'll update checklist with owners and dates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
